review.notes: Triage review of a 317-page system card. Full-document structural scan: code fences balanced (11 pairs, none swallow headings/tables/images), no duplicated title lines. Full-document droppage machine scan: normalized 4-gram containment of extracted PDF page text against the OCR markdown; all 47 low-containment pages were inspected via per-page missing-sentence diff. Render-verified with page crops (dpi 130-200): pages 38 (bullet promoted to heading, plain 'Glossary of recurring terms:' lead line), 50 (footnote 4 body), 214 (plain 'Overall, we find:' lead line and bold bullet promoted to heading), 241 and 275 (two rasterized chart titles kept as # h1 headings), 251-252 (footnote 27/28 bodies and six glued table cells). Pages 39/41 low-containment text is prompt-box content inside figure screenshots and is not a defect. Table-heavy false positives on pages 48/50/251 are HTML tables already present in the OCR. Unnumbered '##' headings matching figure-internal chart titles were machine-flagged as a class but not individually render-verified; see unresolved.

Rendered physical p.214 prints 'Overall, we find:' as a plain body-text lead line before a bullet list, not a numbered section heading. Demoted to plain text.
